landing.title: The Subsonic API, Served From A WebDAV Library
landing.subtitle: Point any Subsonic client at this server and browse music you already have on WebDAV. No Transcoding, No Separate Library To Maintain.
landing.signInDidNothing: That navigation returned here without a session. Check That A Cloudflare Access Application Covers {{path}}, And That The Worker Has {{aud}} And {{team}} Set.
landing.subsonicApiDescription: Full Subsonic 1.16.1. Every Client You Already Have Signs In And Browses.
landing.webdavOriginDescription: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Or Anything Answering PROPFIND. Your Files Never Leave Home.
landing.edgeIndexDescription: Indexed In D1 And Read By Ranged Requests. No Server Holds Your Audio.

unauthorized.title: Access required
unauthorized.defaultMessage: You must authenticate to access this page.

libraries.title: Music libraries
libraries.hint: A library is a WebDAV origin plus a folder inside it. Subsonic clients see each library as a music folder.
libraries.emptyHint: Register a WebDAV origin to give Subsonic clients something to browse.
libraries.enrichPartial: Partially enriched. New tracks enrich on first play, or run the enrichment again.
libraries.enrichStalled: Stopped retrying. Fix the cause, then enrich again.
libraries.enrichPaused: D1's daily write allowance is spent. Paused until {{time}} UTC; the enrichment resumes itself.
libraries.scanEmpty: Scan finished with nothing indexed. Check the library root path, then rescan.
libraries.scanStalled: Stopped retrying. Fix the cause, then rescan.
libraries.scanPaused: D1's daily write allowance is spent. Paused until {{time}} UTC; the scan resumes itself.
libraries.stale: Showing the last known state — the most recent update could not be read.
libraries.scanPausedRequests: Paused at the per-chunk request limit. This is the plan limit, not a fault — the scan continues on the next tick.
libraries.scanPausedDeadline: Paused at the per-chunk time limit. Raise SCAN_CHUNK_DEADLINE_MS, or expect more polls.

users.title: Subsonic users
users.hint: Point a Subsonic client at this server and sign in with one of these usernames. Passwords are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
users.emptyHint: Create an account, then sign in to this server from any Subsonic client.

import.title: Import from another server
import.intro: Bring playlists, favourites, ratings, bookmarks and play counts across from another Subsonic server.
import.pauseNotice: An import pauses the library scan while it runs, so the two do not compete for the daily write allowance.
import.matchNotice: Songs are matched by their path first, then by album and title. Anything that cannot be matched is listed below rather than dropped.
import.noSourcesDescription: Add the server you are moving from to begin.
import.sourceUrlHint: Include the path if the server is behind a reverse proxy, e.g. /sonic.
import.sourcePasswordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
import.playQueueHint: — off by default; it restores a half-finished queue.
import.noRunsDescription: Imports you run will be listed here with anything they could not match.
import.stale: Could not reach the server — these figures may be out of date.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.intro: Dropping an index empties it without unregistering the library, so a rescan can rebuild it from scratch. Registrations, WebDAV passwords, stars, play counts and playlists are all kept.
danger.dropEverythingDescription: Empties every registered library at once. Registrations are kept.
danger.libraryDropDescription: Deletes the scanned index for {{slug}}: every indexed track and every folder. The library and its saved WebDAV password stay registered, and stars, play counts and playlists are kept — a rescan restores them, because track ids are derived from the file path. Press Rescan on the library afterwards to index it again from scratch.
danger.allDropDescription: Deletes the scanned index for {{scope}}: every indexed track and every folder. No library registration, WebDAV password, star, play count or playlist is removed. Press Rescan afterwards to index from scratch.
danger.dropCost: {{songs}} tracks and {{nodes}} folders, billing about {{rows}} rows against the daily write allowance.
danger.dropOutageRisk: A drop this large can exceed the daily row-write allowance. Past that limit the database refuses every query until midnight UTC, including reads — so streaming stops too, not just scanning.
danger.dropped: Index dropped for {{scope}} — {{songs}} tracks removed, about {{rows}} rows billed.
